title: narcissus × albidus subsp. foliosus
intro: Narcissus × albidus subsp. foliosus, commonly known as the striped narcissus, is a subspecies of the narcissus plant, characterized by its unique foliage and flower morphology. The health benefits of this plant include its potential to boost the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus × albidus subsp. foliosus include its ability to act as a natural antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic agent, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
